meta.title: Procurement & BOM Deployment Tracker
meta.note: State lives in this JSON (data/os_status/deployment-state.json). Edit state here; render via skills/os_portal/build_deployment_tracker.py. Reference a stage in chat as P1-P8; an edge case as EC-<stage>-N. Update via the documented protocol (Hermes logs a change, Giles verifies, then signs off).

edge_cases.title: '+' and _revN in pack filenames break resolve_pack -> file skipped as not_found

edge_cases.title: Phantom GIDs cause 'could not fetch task' 404s on pack write
edge_cases.notes: From BOM commit Stage-5 timeout. Recovery = Giles finds real GIDs, patch parts_control.asana_task_gid, re-run drawing Stage 4. DO NOT re-run BOM commit. pack_assign handler now skips 404s safely.

edge_cases.title: No automatic flag when a parts_control row lacks any pack link after sync
edge_cases.notes: RESOLVED 2026-08-27: unassigned_parts_net.py flags unassigned parts per job + stage_pack_proposals.py classifies unique/ambiguous/no-pack. 109 ambiguous + 148 no-pack flagged for review (never auto-assigned).

stages.verify_with: Legacy scan on one project (e.g. 1037) -> confirm pack GIDs; run --stop-after 3, confirm build_assembly_pack_gid populated; confirm execute_requests handles pack_assign.

DONE 2026-08-27: rfq_tracker.py marks sent/received + reports counts per SQR/supplier (verified).

DONE 2026-08-27: match_quote_to_sqr.py matches returned quotes by EXPLICIT SQR or by DOMAIN (separate-chain quotes) -> fills supplier_quote_ref + confirmation_number + invoice_number + captures quote_sender into supplier_contacts (per-contact reply routing). Verified on SQR-46787.
HOOK PENDING: wire 03_proposal_engine.py inbound matcher to auto-call match_quote_to_sqr on every inbound quote/confirmation/invoice

edge_cases.title: No outbound email capability at all - the email pipeline is inbound-only
edge_cases.notes: RESOLVED 2026-08-27: create_rfq_draft.py creates Outlook Drafts via Graph, issues next SQR, logs to rfq_outbox. Test draft [TEST - Hermes P4] created for Giles to review in Drafts. Never auto-sends.

edge_cases.title: SQR issuance not modelled - SQR only appears when a supplier quotes back
edge_cases.notes: RESOLVED 2026-08-27: rfq_outbox issues outbound SQRs; match_quote_to_sqr.py links returned quotes back to the issued SQR by domain/explicit-ref, holding supplier quote + confirmation + invoice numbers.

edge_cases.title: Quotes arrive in a separate chain from the RFQ request - no direct thread link
edge_cases.notes: RESOLVED 2026-08-27: domain-based matching in match_quote_to_sqr.py links a separate-chain quote to the issued SQR. Quote sender captured for per-contact reply routing.

edge_cases.title: Multiple contacts per company - a quote often comes from a different person than the generic inbox
edge_cases.notes: supplier_contacts table now models many contacts/company (source=project vs quote_sender). Email-scrape for bulk reverse-engineering deferred by Hermes recommendation (mess risk); quote-sender capture is the organic safe path.

stages.verify_with: Drive RFQ-needed task -> Outlook Draft appears (NOT sent) with part list + SQR. Simulate returned quote -> 01->03 -> QA sheet HITL + rfq_outbox received tick. Assert no code path auto-sends.
